findings.title: Oversize fallback replaces the whole array, ignoring the trimmed common prefix and suffix
findings.why: The fallback emits a replace of the entire array at `path`, even though the matching head and tail were already trimmed. A large array with a small differing middle yields a patch as big as the target array, which contradicts the createPatch doc comment ('describing only what changed'). The result is still correct when applied.
